# Contributing Guidelines

This repository is an open-source project, but it is maintained strictly as a personal workspace. 

## Contribution Rules

* **Bug Reports Only:** Please use GitHub Issues exclusively to report reproducible bugs. 
* **No Support Questions:** Do not open issues for help, questions, or setup assistance, unless there is a 'bug'. 
* **No Feature Requests:** Feature suggestions are not being accepted.
* **No Pull Requests:** External PRs will be closed without review, at my discretion.

Thank you for respecting the boundaries of this solitary project!
